Package com.societegenerale.failover.observable.metrics

Class SnapshotBaseline

java.lang.Object
com.societegenerale.failover.observable.metrics.SnapshotBaseline
public final class SnapshotBaseline extends Object
Reset-aware carry-forward shared by every JDBC-writing side of the shared-store tier (consistency rule, design §5.3) — the dashboard's own SnapshotStoreJdbc and any peer writing directly to the same table (JDBC-direct publisher). Peer snapshots carry cumulative counter totals that reset to zero when the peer restarts; without correction the cluster aggregate would drop by that instance's pre-restart counts.

On each upsert the writer keeps the incoming snapshot as the instance's raw value and, when a counter reset is detected (cumulative total went backwards), folds the previous raw snapshot into a per-instance baseline. The summary served for the instance is baseline + raw, so the instant aggregate stays monotonic across peer restarts — matching the behaviour the series sampler already guarantees for the trend graph.

Limitation: a reset is invisible if the peer regrows past its previous total between two pushes; that window is one push interval (15s by default), the same limitation Prometheus rate() has.

Lives here (rather than the dashboard module) so both the dashboard-side JDBC store and a peer's JDBC-direct publisher can share the same carry-forward logic without either depending on the other.

Author:
Anand Manissery

  • Method Details

    • next

      public static MetricsSummary next(MetricsSummary previousRaw, MetricsSummary previousBaseline, MetricsSummary incoming)
      Computes the baseline to store alongside an incoming snapshot.
      Parameters:
      previousRaw - the instance's previously stored raw snapshot (null if first push)
      previousBaseline - the instance's current baseline (null if none accumulated yet)
      incoming - the snapshot just pushed
      Returns:
      the new baseline: unchanged unless incoming reveals a counter reset, in which case the previous raw totals are folded in; null when there is nothing to carry forward

    • combined

      public static MetricsSummary combined(MetricsSummary baseline, MetricsSummary raw)
      Combines the carried baseline with the current raw snapshot.
      Parameters:
      baseline - the instance's carried baseline, or null if none accumulated yet
      raw - the instance's current raw snapshot
      Returns:
      the summary to serve for an instance: baseline + raw when a baseline exists, otherwise raw as-is
